custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the blue stamped logo. In AI images, text/logos often melt or become nonsensical. Verify if the characters are coherent or if they represent an artifact. Also, check the stitching: do the holes for the stitches look punched through the leather, or do they sit unnaturally on top?
